profile.audience: 한국 창업자 겸 공간/생활 트렌드 에디터
profile.purpose: 현장성이 있는 세계관의 수요, 동선, 공간, 리테일, 생활 루틴 신호 발굴
source_mix: NVIDIA Korea persona and ecosystem signals
public geotag and visual weak signals
profile.output_mode: physical world signal brief plus space, product, and content angles
profile.tone: Korean product writing style: concrete, observational, low-hype, scene-first, action-oriented

selected_sources.name: OpenSurvey Trend Reports
selected_sources.notes: Use public consumer trend reports for Korean market context.

selected_sources.name: KOSIS
selected_sources.notes: Primary Korean statistics. Use for grounding narratives in data.

selected_sources.name: McKinsey Insights
selected_sources.notes: Useful for corporate strategy framing; watch for generic claims.

selected_sources.name: NVIDIA Nemotron-Personas-Korea
selected_sources.notes: Open synthetic Korean persona dataset. Use as an interpretation and scenario-testing layer, not a substitute for user research, surveys, or transaction data.

selected_sources.name: NVIDIA Korea Personas Article
selected_sources.notes: Official Korean article explaining Nemotron-Personas-Korea. Use for source-backed description and caveats.

selected_sources.name: NVIDIA Blog Korea
selected_sources.notes: Official NVIDIA Korea blog. Use for Korean AI developer ecosystem, Nemotron, sovereign AI, physical AI, and enterprise deployment signals.

selected_sources.name: NVIDIA AI Day Seoul
selected_sources.notes: Use for Korean NVIDIA developer, startup, enterprise, and AI Day ecosystem signals.

selected_sources.name: NVIDIA Korea AI Infrastructure Newsroom
selected_sources.notes: Use for Korea AI infrastructure, AI factories, sovereign cloud, physical AI, manufacturing, and robotics signals.

selected_sources.name: YouTube Korea Vlog Routes
selected_sources.notes: Manual watchlist for public Korean vlogs and route videos. Use titles, descriptions, visible chapters, locations, and repeated visit sequences; treat claims as weak until verified with maps, reservations, or public data.

selected_sources.name: Seoul Open Data Plaza
selected_sources.notes: Primary public data source for Seoul mobility, local business, population, and facility datasets. Use to ground spatial narratives.

selected_sources.name: YouTube Korea Place Shorts
selected_sources.notes: Manual weak-signal source for place-based Shorts. Track repeated places, camera sequence, waiting language, and comments asking for location; verify elsewhere before strong claims.

selected_sources.name: Instagram Public Geotags
selected_sources.notes: Weak visual signal. Use public geotag pages or user-provided links only. Track what people photograph, not private account content.

selected_sources.name: Naver Map Place Reviews
selected_sources.notes: Manual watchlist. Use public place pages, review counts, recent review language, photo patterns, and nearby clusters only. Do not bypass login, rate limits, or copy full reviews.

selected_sources.name: Kakao Map Place Reviews
selected_sources.notes: Manual watchlist for cross-checking Naver Map. Compare review language, route context, hours, parking, waiting, and local repeat-visit cues.

selected_sources.name: CatchTable
selected_sources.notes: Use visible reservation availability, waiting, region/category clustering, and public descriptions as demand signals. Do not automate booking or access logged-in data.

selected_sources.name: Tabling
selected_sources.notes: Use visible waiting/queue and restaurant discovery surfaces as weak demand signals. Verify with map reviews, social posts, and repeat observations.

selected_sources.name: 29CM
selected_sources.notes: Use public curation, ranking, brand language, and offline pop-up/store signals to read lifestyle taste shifts.

selected_sources.name: Musinsa
selected_sources.notes: Use public rankings, brand campaigns, store/pop-up language, and category movement as taste and retail execution signals.

selected_sources.name: Todayhouse
selected_sources.notes: Use public home/living trend surfaces to connect online taste with physical rooms, objects, storage, and routines.

selected_sources.name: Small Enterprise Commercial Area Information
selected_sources.notes: Use public commercial-area data to validate whether attention is changing local business density, category mix, or rent pressure.

selected_sources.name: KB Research
selected_sources.notes: Useful for wealth reports, finance, real estate, and Korean consumer/investor behavior.

selected_sources.name: YouTube Culture & Trends
selected_sources.notes: Use for platform-level trend analysis and creator economy context.

selected_sources.name: KOCCA Reports
selected_sources.notes: Primary Korean content industry source. Use for IP, games, media, and creator economy context.

selected_sources.name: YouTube Trending Korea
selected_sources.notes: Manual watchlist for Korean YouTube trending videos. Use titles, channels, descriptions, and visible metrics only; verify claims elsewhere.

selected_sources.name: Google Trends Korea
selected_sources.notes: Use as public interest signal. Treat as demand discovery, not factual proof.

selected_sources.name: GeekNews
selected_sources.notes: Strong Korean developer/startup signal source; verify original links where possible.

selected_sources.name: Venturesquare
selected_sources.notes: Korean startup ecosystem and funding coverage.

selected_sources.name: Startup Alliance Korea
selected_sources.notes: Use for ecosystem reports, startup policy, and Korea market context.

selected_sources.name: Platum
selected_sources.notes: Korean startup news and funding signal.

selected_sources.name: Apple App Store Top Free Korea
selected_sources.notes: Fetchable public ranking source. Use rank movement as product-discovery signal, not proof of revenue.

selected_sources.name: Bank of Korea
selected_sources.notes: Primary macroeconomic source for Korea.

selected_sources.name: Mobile Index
selected_sources.notes: Korean mobile app market watchlist. Use public charts or reports only.

selected_sources.name: Apple App Store Top Paid Korea
selected_sources.notes: Fetchable public paid-app ranking source. Combine with reviews, downloads, and category context before drawing conclusions.

selected_sources.name: Y Combinator Blog
selected_sources.notes: Founder and startup signal source; useful for company formation, fundraising, and founder advice.

selected_sources.name: Lenny's Newsletter
selected_sources.notes: Use public posts only. Strong for product/growth practice and content angles.

selected_sources.name: a16z
selected_sources.notes: High-quality narrative and market map source. Feed path changes; keep as watchlist until verified.
